g.text: FIG 1 PLAN, FLOW SECTION AND FRONT WALL UI - OSM-1
ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETRES - GEOMETRY GENERATED FROM mechanical/constants.py AND routed pcb_geometry.json
PLAN + SECTION A-A + FRONT WALL UI
PWM fan, J10 at rear centre
3 x dia6 nostrils, clear below panel
Three dia6 nostrils, front wall - sample entry
Cleanable woven PTFE mesh filter, front drawer
Qwiic port beside every socket (own mux channel)
Upright parametric cartridges facing the central channel
ESP32 + two ADS1115s; board top is the chamber floor
40 mm PWM exhaust fan, J10 harness at rear centre
dia6 grommet; four front buttons MEASURE/OK, MENU/BACK, BOOT, RESET; plain lid
MEASURE/OK + MENU/BACK are user buttons; BOOT/RESET are service buttons; OTA updates
Licensed vendor STEP models are not in this repo; module shapes are parametric OSM-1 representations.
